Vendored from https://github.com/stevenjoezhang/live2d-widget tag v0.9.2 (GPL-3.0).
autoload.js is patched to load CSS/JS/runtime from /static/live2d/ (same origin).
Original autoload.js is kept as autoload.upstream.js.
chunk/index.js and chunk/index2.js are required by waifu-tips.js for Cubism 2 and Cubism 3/4 models.
